name: Conduit
description: A simple self-contained Rust-based Matrix server. Fully configurable with Environment Variables! (Beta) Check Support Thread for NGINX conf. Conduit is Beta, meaning you can join and participate in most Matrix rooms, but not all features are supported and you might run into bugs from time to time. Conduit is a lightweight open-source server implementation of the Matrix Specification with a focus on easy setup and low system requirements. That means you can make your own Conduit setup in just a few minutes. Conduit keeps things simple, it's a single binary with an embedded database and can be much faster than other server implementations in some cases.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: This is the only directory where Conduit will save its data

variables.name: CONDUIT_SERVER_NAME
variables.description: The domain name of your server. You can't change this later.

variables.name: CONDUIT_ALLOW_REGISTRATION
variables.description: Enables registration. If set to false, no users can register on this server.

variables.name: CONDUIT_ALLOW_FEDERATION
variables.description: If set to true, you can connect and communicate with other Matrix servers

variables.name: CONDUIT_ENABLE_LIGHTNING_BOLT
variables.description: Add lightning bolt to registered users names

variables.name: CONDUIT_MAX_REQUEST_SIZE
variables.description: Max size for uploads, in bytes

variables.name: CONDUIT_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS
variables.description: How many requests Conduit sends to other servers at the same time

variables.name: CONDUIT_TRUSTED_SERVERS
variables.description: Server to get public keys from. You probably shouldn't change this. Default is: [
